_what: DATA for the engine rows of answer-questions-about-many-states: the person's lists this tool reads and keeps (each made once, the first time a row runs), the files a classifier family needs, where a model's weights are fetched from, and every word a row answers with. The code names none of these.

classifiers.label: Question classifiers
classifiers.about: The classifier models that answer your question sets on this Mac: which family each is and where its weights come from. Get one ready before its first run; the identity of its weights is written back here.

fields.label: Hugging Face repository
fields.free_text_because: The repository the weights are fetched from, owner/name, as the model's own page names it.

fields.label: Revision
fields.free_text_because: The pinned commit of the weights, so they cannot change under the row.

fields.label: Weights identity
fields.free_text_because: The BLAKE3 identity of the fetched files, written by the tool.

questions.label: Classifier questions
questions.about: The questions a classifier asks about every state, grouped into sets. A run asks one set, in its order.

fields.label: Set
fields.free_text_because: The name of the question set this question belongs to, chosen by the person.

fields.label: Question
fields.free_text_because: The question in the person's own words.

fields.label: Options
fields.free_text_because: The question's options as JSON: a choice's {option: description or null} (2 to 255), a score's ordered levels (2 to 10), a noul's optional {true, false}.

states.label: States to classify
states.about: The lines, records or messages a classifier is asked about, grouped into sets. A run asks every state of one set.

fields.label: Set
fields.free_text_because: The name of the state set this state belongs to, chosen by the person.

fields.label: State
fields.free_text_because: The state itself: text, or JSON the model reads written compactly.

settings.label: Classifier settings
settings.about: How a classifier run is done: the layout, the dtype, how much one GPU pass holds and how much of a state the model reads.

runs.label: Classifier runs
runs.about: Each run of a question set over a state set: what it asked, how far it is, and what it measured. Set Stop to end a run after the batch in hand.

fields.label: Question set
fields.free_text_because: The question set's name, copied from the questions.

fields.label: State set
fields.free_text_because: The state set's name, copied from the states.

fields.label: Machine
fields.free_text_because: What the run measured on (MLX version, device), written by the tool.

fields.label: Identity
fields.free_text_because: The BLAKE3 identity of everything the run asked, written by the tool.

fields.label: Why it failed
fields.free_text_because: The program's own words when a run fails.

answers.label: Classifier answers
answers.about: What a run answered for each state: for every question, the probability of each option.

fields.label: Answers
fields.free_text_because: The answers as JSON, {question id: {type, probabilities, choice | score | noul, confidence}}, written by the tool.

words.no_door: This run was not handed the person's records door.
words.no_kept_folder: This run was not handed the tool's kept folder (its row declares invoke.kept_folder).
words.no_program: This run was not handed a Python with MLX: grant start-a-program its program, a python3 on this Mac that imports mlx, tokenizers and numpy.
words.no_classifier: There is no row {id} in the Question classifiers list.
words.not_ready: The classifier {id} is not ready on this Mac yet: run tool:get-a-classifier-ready-on-this-mac for it first.
words.no_questions: The question set {set} has no questions in the Classifier questions list.
words.no_states: The state set {set} has no states in the States to classify list.
words.no_settings: There is no row {id} in the Classifier settings list.
words.gated: {repo} answered {status}: its weights need a Hugging Face account that accepted the model's terms, and this tool has no way to send one yet.
words.family_unknown: This tool runs the classifier families {families}, not {family}.
words.no_run: There is no run {id} in the Classifier runs list.

settings_meaning.layout: independent (one row per question, no question sees another) or packed (all questions in one prefix, several times fewer tokens)
settings_meaning.tokens_per_batch: how many tokens one GPU pass may hold
settings_meaning.max_state_tokens: the most tokens of one state the model reads
